message.content: During their meeting at "Central Perk," Li Hua suggested several design elements for Yuriko's studio homepage. Specifically, Li Hua proposed a user feedback section that included both a simple form for users to leave comments or suggestions and a star rating system. Additionally, Li Hua suggested incorporating testimonials to provide additional credibility and build trust with potential clients. The feedback section was to match the overall aesthetic of the studio, likely featuring soft and calming pastel colors. These design features were aimed at enhancing the usability and appeal of the homepage, ensuring that visitors had a positive experience and could easily interact with the site.
